strings.zh: 等我还想再对战的时候{NEWLINE}我会打电话给你的！
strings.en: I’ll give you a call whenever{NEWLINE}I want to battle again!

strings.zh: 我还想如果找到什么东西的话{NEWLINE}就分给你呢。
strings.en: I figured that if I found anything in the{NEWLINE}area, I’d give it to you...

strings.zh: 你果然还是很想和我交换{NEWLINE}电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You wanna trade phone numbers{NEWLINE}after all? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你来了啊！{SCROLL}我把精灵找到的{NEWLINE}果实给你吧！请收下！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, here you are!{SCROLL}I’ll give you this Berry that my Pokémon{NEWLINE}found. Here you go!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 虽然就在附近,{NEWLINE}但是用电话交流{CLEAR}感觉挺有趣的。
strings.en: You’re right nearby, but talking{NEWLINE}on the phone is kind of fun anyway.

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}一直都在坚持锻炼！{SCROLL}因为我不想输给{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} is always training!{SCROLL}Because I don’t want to lose to{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}!
strings.notes: US 0681/7 | RV072: meaning: 因为我不想输 = I don't want to lose

strings.zh: 来,你听我说！{NEWLINE}前段时间好不容易找到的{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11}还是逃掉了！{SCROLL}好可惜啊！{NEWLINE}我好想抓它的！
strings.en: Hey! Psst! Listen!{NEWLINE}This {VAR:0100:11} I ran into earlier{CLEAR}just up and ran away!{SCROLL}I was so disappointed!{NEWLINE}I really wanted to catch it, too!

strings.zh: 你抓到{VAR:0100:11}了吗？{NEWLINE}这在附近经常能找到的！
strings.en: Did you catch any {VAR:0100:11} yet?{NEWLINE}You can always find them around here.

strings.zh: 来和我培养的精灵{NEWLINE}来一场对战怎么样？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你到了{CLEAR}就来找我吧！
strings.en: Will you battle my trained Pokémon?{SCROLL}We’re on {VAR:0104:3}, so give me{NEWLINE}a shout when you’re in the area!

strings.zh: 现在你在哪？{NEWLINE}在{VAR:0104:3}吗？{CLEAR}难道你忘了{CLEAR}和我的对战了吗？
strings.en: Where are you now?{NEWLINE}Close to {VAR:0104:3}?{CLEAR}Don’t tell me you forgot we were going{CLEAR}to have a battle?

strings.zh: 我在森林里寻找{NEWLINE}精灵踪迹的时候{CLEAR}手指被叶子割伤了,{SCROLL}稍微出了点血,{NEWLINE}不过没什么关系！
strings.en: While I was walking around the forest{NEWLINE}trying to find Pokémon, I cut my finger{CLEAR}on a leaf!{SCROLL}It bled a little, but I’m fine.

strings.zh: 我找到了精灵{NEWLINE}非常喜欢的果实！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你来拿！
strings.en: I found a Berry that{NEWLINE}Pokémon really love!{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting at {VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}for you to come get it!

strings.zh: 嗯⋯⋯我可是{NEWLINE}很想把果实给你啊。{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你来拿！
strings.en: Hmm... I really do want to give you this{NEWLINE}Berry.{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting on {VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}for you to come get it!
strings.notes: US 0681/14 | RV072: meaning: speaker is 'I'; restored the wait
